Twelve comments

The Caucus Reel

Submitted due to a request from “cluaintarbh”.

This reel was composed by (Canadian) Jean Duval in honor of the “Caucus in Secaucus” (Secaucus is a place in New Jersey usa). It was recorded by the Raffertys on the Dangerous Reel cd.

Its a great tune.

↳ Posted by LH on April 5th, 2004.

Caucus

Thank you very much for posting this. Appreciate it.

A fellow flute player

↳ Posted by cluaintarbh on April 6th, 2004.

Great tune

I posted this as a “Gan Ainm” yesterday, but you beat me to it.
Conal O’Grada played it at Hammy’s “flute-meeting” in Ballyvourney 2 months ago, so it’s made it down to Cork. Glad to have the name and composer of it. Great flute tune.

↳ Posted by Kenny on June 25th, 2006.

Jean composed the tune for Mike Rafferty, whom he had just met for the first time at a Comhaltas Convention (the caucus in the title). He worked it out early on the Sunday morning in the hotel bedroom we were sharing. I was still prostate after late night sessions but listened to the whole process. Jean asked me for ideas for a name, and I came up with “The Caucus _at_ Secaucus.”

↳ Posted by Stiamh on July 22nd, 2008.
